description: Use this when the user wants a week of social posts planned, or answers yes or no to planning their week. It drafts one batch of 5 posts for the active brand: a new image, a caption and a suggested day and time for each. Without confirm it returns the price and whether the batch fits the account’s posting allowance, and spends nothing. Confirm:true starts the batch and bills credits; read the posts with get_job. Decline:true records that the user said no.

confirm.description: true only after the user agreed to the price

decline.description: true when the user said no

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

timezone.description: the user’s IANA timezone when known, e.g. America/New_York; the suggested times use it

name: plan_week
title: Plan a week of posts
